chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ḥadīd, from Jamīl, from some of his companions, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them:
Concerning a man who broke another man's hand, then the man's hand healed, he said: “There is no qisas in this case, but the arsh is to be given.”

key_terms.الْأَرْشَ: monetary compensation assessed for bodily injury
key_terms.قِصَاصٌ: retaliatory legal punishment in kind for injury
key_terms.كَسَرَ: broke; caused a fracture or break

ai.seo_question: If a person breaks someone's hand and it later heals, is qisas still applied or is compensation paid instead?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding bodily injury when the injured limb later heals. It states that qisas does not apply in this case, but financial compensation for the injury is still due.
